verdicts.reason: A keeps the original hierarchy and reading order (logo, can, headline, chips, CTA, legal) but it is mostly a shrunk copy. The ingredient chips and legal line are now very small, the big decorative circle has moved to crowd the logo, and about 150px of dead space sits under the legal line. B breaks the design: the 'Build Your Mix' CTA is cut down to a chip-sized pill jammed into a cramped top-left cluster with the ingredient tags, out of sequence. The headline wraps with an orphaned 'glow.', and the lower third of the canvas is empty.
